title: Golden Registry & Regeneration
description: Maintain a registry of generated goldens (one per template contract). Each entry pins the template id + version, generation metadata, and stable logical root. Validation runs materialize generated substrates into managed paths outside scenarios/ by default.

requirements.title: Golden registry domain module
requirements.description: SQLite-backed domain module under api/internal/golden/{model,sqlite,schema}.go,sql storing slug, template_id, template_version_pinned, logical root/materialization metadata, created_at, and last_regenerated_at.

validation.notes: Golden registry row round-trips through SQLite (slug, template, pinned version, logical root, materialization metadata).
reference-react-vite golden slug registered and listed live 2026-05-29; generated materialization is now the active substrate model.

requirements.title: Regenerate operation
requirements.description: Service/materializer path that invokes the template generator into a managed generated path, captures the produced template version, and updates template/materialization metadata without requiring a committed reference tree.

validation.notes: Regenerate updates pinned version and persists last_regenerated_at.
